content.title: The Second Class of Surah Mashq is Going to Be Held Tonight!
content.subtitle: Sunday from 9:00 PM—Are you participating?
content.body:
Do we realize that our prayers remain incomplete solely because our recitation is not correct? According to the narration of the Hadith, one of the main conditions for prayer to be valid and accepted is that the Qira'at, or recitation, must be correct (Sahih Bukhari: 757).

When the night is deep, we leave our peaceful beds and stand before our Lord. On Jumu'ah, we go to the mosque a little early. Even amidst extreme busyness, we perform prayers on time; yet despite all this, we remain deprived of the benefits gained through performing prayer. Could the reason for this be that our recitation is not correct? Our prayers remain incomplete.

Acquiring Necessary Knowledge is Fard

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Seeking (necessary Islamic) knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim." (Sunan Ibn Majah: 224).

We all know that prayer is an obligatory act of worship; but do we have the necessary Islamic knowledge to perform that obligatory act properly? Have we checked whether whatever we are reciting or reading in prayer is Sahih and correct? Or, due to various busy schedules or growing older, we no longer get the opportunity to take out separate time to practice the Quran. It has been going on the same way ever since we learned it once in our childhood.

Completely Free Class Under the Supervision of an Experienced Ustad

From that point of realization, Muslims Day has brought a completely free ‘Surah Mashq’ class. Here, through an experienced Ustad, the Surahs commonly recited in prayer will be taught correctly. And right in the class, recitations will be heard and mistakes will be corrected—so that everyone can perform prayer without errors, Insha'Allah.

Following the spontaneous participation of numerous brothers in our first experimental class after Fajr on Wednesday, November 12, this class will now be held regularly twice a week (for men only):

  • Sunday: From 9:00 PM (Our second class will be held tonight, Insha'Allah!)

  • Wednesday: From 6:15 AM

How to Join the Class and Submit Recitations

Step 1: Join the Official Facebook Group. Stay connected to our official Facebook group to get regular updates and necessary instructions for the class. Click here.

Step 2: Rules for Joining the Class Directly from the App: You will get the joining link directly in the Muslims Day app every week during the class time. In this case:

  1. First, open the Muslims Day app.

  1. You will see a notice card right below the prayer schedule and the ‘Alarm’ & ‘Calendar’ buttons at the top of the Home feed.

  1. At the scheduled time, a notice card will appear there—tapping on it will allow you to join the class directly.

Separate Arrangement for Sisters

For the sisters who want to join the Mashq class, keeping Pardah in mind, we have arranged a completely separate group and class for them under Kahf Kids. Therefore, those of you who are interested are humbly requested to join this WhatsApp group: Join the class. (Please, no brother should join this group. It is strictly prohibited for brothers)

footer_button.hint: Team Muslims Day always wants a Muslim to become a better Muslim today than yesterday. In continuation of that effort, we have organized this free Quran and Surah Mashq class. Along with the incidental expenses of this completely free class, there are regular large expenses in various sectors including servers, development, and maintenance to keep the Muslims Day app running and enriched. To keep all services of the app open for everyone and to move this beneficial mission forward, you too can participate financially if you wish.
